master_potential_status: coupled gravito-electromagnetic axial/polar master potentials known from classic literature and modern QNM work
validation_data: published Leaver/WKB spectra including near-extremal behavior
recommended_role: clean charged benchmark before regular metrics
main_risk: not a single pure-gravity Regge-Wheeler potential; astrophysical charge is weakly motivated

master_potential_status: explicit static RN-like metric and scalar/electromagnetic/gravitational perturbation potentials in paper
validation_data: published 6th-order WKB tables for axial and polar gravitational modes
recommended_role: strongest simple non-Schwarzschild static case for the pipeline
main_risk: uses simplifying assumption on projected Weyl perturbation; effective brane model not full bulk solution

physics_level: GR coupled to nonlinear electrodynamics or effective anisotropic source
master_potential_status: asymptotically flat axial gravitational master equation implemented locally
validation_data: published 3rd-order WKB tables reproduced below about 0.9 percent
recommended_role: first high-value popular regular-BH target now validated
main_risk: source interpretation and matter perturbation must be fixed before claims; polar sector more involved

validation_data: published ell=2 n=0 Prony table reproduced below about 0.8 percent and ell=2 n=1 WKB-8 table reproduced below 1 percent
recommended_role: second regular-BH/overtone-sensitive target now validated for the fundamental mode and first overtone
main_risk: first-overtone extraction uses matrix pencil and still needs Leaver/high-order WKB or a controlled multi-mode solver for final precision spectroscopy

physics_level: regular black hole / black-bounce with multiple matter-source interpretations
master_potential_status: exact master equations derived for different source interpretations
recommended_role: conceptual example that same metric can give different ringdown if source is changed
main_risk: very new and less directly comparable with standard black-hole-only models

master_potential_status: axial perturbation equations and QNM methods exist but require numerical background functions
main_risk: too heavy for first module because background solutions and hyperbolicity domain must be reproduced

recommended_role: useful theoretical umbrella for future extensions
